The save reader Nimby3D uses to export stations, track and elevation from a NIMBY Rails save
(toolkit_savereader.py, toolkit_coordedit.py, toolkit_binary.py, and toolkit_autotrack.py for its verified
station registry), copied from the NIMBY Timetable
Toolkit by the same author (MIT, LICENSE.toolkit), and the official 64-bit Zstandard runtime
(libzstd.dll, BSD, zstd/LICENSE and zstd/SOURCE.md) that reading a save needs.
